body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Daesung Info(www.busdvr.com) made a debut to global market successfully during CES 2008, presenting ‘Bus DVR System’, its integrated device of DVR and service recorder.

As a car-use DVR composed of four cameras and a DVR system, it is compatible with service recorder that records the vehicles’ speeding, starting with doors open and sudden start/stop. Supporting built-in battery discharge prevention device, it also solved vibration problem caused by car driving.
It features compact size to be fitted in the existing AV system of the vehicles. The company plans to develop its next version which also can check a brake, RPM, idling and gear shift.

“Through the exhibition, we saw so much potential in the US market having many bus, taxi and rental boat companies which could adopt our DVR products, and we built a good relationship with new business partners from Middle and South America and Canada,” the company said. “In the future, short recording function by using CF card also would be included for rental services.”
